name: wake-on-lan
description: Remote wake-up computers on a local network via Wake-on-LAN (Magic Packet). Manage host configurations (add, edit, remove, list) and send wake-up signals by host name or MAC address. Triggered whenever the user mentions "开机", "远程开机", "唤醒主机", "wake on lan", "WOL", "远程唤醒", "帮我把XX电脑打开", "服务器关了帮我开一下", "把电脑开着", or asks to start a computer on the local network. Also use for managing wake-up host lists.
